scope: Focused floor / top prop removal / lower crystal revision; no merge
artistic_verdict: Upper combat area is clearer after removing the three lanterns, cart and wheel. A warm flat walking plane and darker natural bedrock replace the old gray-brick strip. Two large distinct amber outcrops sit at the grounded lower corners; the loose board-side deposits are hidden. Native cluster economy and existing character/UI readability are retained.
limitations: Static art-only Unity render, not live combat or device testing.
Original shared board and UI geometry remains unchanged, including inherited fractional edge rounding.
Review scene excluded from builds; production Game is unchanged.
